properties.name: konfigyr.crypto.x509.register-legacy-algorithms
properties.description: Whether to register RSA 2048-bit algorithms (x509:RSA-2048-SIGNING, x509:RSA-2048-ENCRYPTION) for interoperability with counterparties that do not accept larger RSA keys. RSA 2048 meets the NIST SP 800-131A Rev 2 minimum but is below the preferred key size and must not be used in new designs. Prefer the 3072 or 4096-bit variants instead. Defaults to false.
